summary: Implemented the grid-sampled patch feature without running any tests or repository code, per your instructions. Changes: monai/data/utils.py (iter_patch yields (patch, coords) pairs with the coordinate docstring; set_rnd skips __-prefixed attributes); monai/data/grid_dataset.py (new PatchIter, reworked GridPatchDataset with injected patch_iter, transform and with_coordinates, NotImplementedError for missing len, PatchDataset docstring uses float); monai/data/__init__.py exports PatchIter; docs/source/data.rst gets a PatchIter autodoc entry; new tests/test_grid_dataset.py with test_shape, test_loading_array and an extra test_missing_len. No commits made. Unverified risks: the expected literals have four decimals but the spec's tolerance is 1e-5, so test_loading_array may fail on rounding; the two-worker pinned values depend on worker seeding I could not confirm. Choices: test images are np.arange(16) reshaped to 1x4x4 (consistent with the expected values), and each loader block reseeds with set_determinism(1234) through a helper. Line-length check passes for the new and edited grid_dataset and test files; three long lines in utils.py (232-234) predate this change and were left alone.
